call_points.text: FY27 expected to be a better growth year than FY26, but management declined to give a numeric revenue guidance.
FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 16%-16.1%, balancing AI-led efficiency against client price cuts and AI investment.
12-month backlog closed at $300.4 million, up 13.5% YoY in USD and 24.4% in INR; management expects it to execute within 12 months.
U.K. renewals were signed at 10%-15% discounts, and management said discounts could go higher as AI reduces effort.
Operating cash flow for FY26 was ₹542 Cr, up 35% YoY; cash rose 51% to ₹938 Cr.
Final dividend of ₹16 per share declared, on top of ₹8 interim, totalling 480% of face value.
Effective tax rate guided at 24.5%-24.7% going forward, after a Q4 provision reversal lowered the rate.
AI-led deals now represent 9% of the order book, up from 3% two quarters ago, but average deal size is around $1 million.
M&A focus shifting to domain capabilities; management is actively looking at best use of growing cash.
FCA deal has started ramping up with more than 60 on-site resources; full ramp expected by end of Q1.
